description.value: Houston Leisure Centre is a municipal recreation facility operated by the District of Houston in northern BC's Bulkley Valley. It features a swimming pool and offers programs for both residents and visitors. For touring cyclists on Highway 16, it may provide a welcome stop for recreation and refreshment in this small community.

No specific amenities (washrooms, showers, bike parking, water) are explicitly mentioned in the available text, so all amenity fields must be null despite the likelihood a pool facility would have them.
